items.title: Dodgers place struggling closer Edwin Díaz on injured list as bullpen woes continue

items.title: Algorithms amplified World Cup racism, says report
items.summary: Racist abuse aimed at England footballers on social media was amplified during the World Cup by algorithms designed to maximise engagement and profit, according to new research.
items.whyItMatters: Football creates regular global sports momentum and quick-return storylines.

items.title: Tongue & Robinson cut Headingley ball in half
items.summary: England seamers Josh Tongue and Ollie Robinson find a solution as to who keeps the ball after the both claim a five-wicket haul at Headingley - split it in half.
